script:
N=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/events/count" --field .)
control-agent-server ws start "/sockets/events/$A" --name f05-a-noop --duration 300
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/run" --expect 200 --check success eq true --save F05.run-finished-noop/run
control-agent-server ws read f05-a-noop --contains '"key": "full_state"' --expect-min 2 --wait 30
control-agent-server ws stop f05-a-noop --contains '"key": "execution_status"' --expect-none --save F05.run-finished-noop/frames
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/events/count" --check . eq "$N" --save F05.run-finished-noop/count
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A" --check execution_status eq finished
